comment: Recovered Dilla/artist material is kept distinct from the engine's own progressions. Artist rows below restore the historical pub4 ARTIST_VERIFIED_PROGRESSIONS table with source notes and aliases deduplicated; engine_modules are studies, not track transcriptions. Melody motifs are only the measured/legacy pitch material actually retained by that source, not complete note-for-note song melodies. Published chart references (including Flying Lotus Never Catch Me) have their own source tier and are not mislabeled as the narrower artist_verified corpus. The 2026-11-22 ORIGINAL AUTHENTICS audit (see authentics_audit) gave every render-facing row structured citations, fixed two misattributions and aligned the Accordion row to its published chart.

source_status.restored_legacy_unverified: Restored from the earlier pub4 table. This describes repository provenance only; it does not certify the musical transcription independently.
source_status.community_chart_reference: Aligned to a community-maintained published chart (Hooktheory TheoryTab). Chord spellings follow the cited chart; timing stays an engine even-slot model.

timing_status.published_form: A cited source explicitly describes the section or chord durations represented by chord_bars.
timing_status.source_loop_length_only: A source describes the loop length, but individual chord onsets have not been digitized; chord_bars are the engine's even-slot approximation.
timing_status.engine_grid_assumption: Chord durations are evenly allocated for rendering; they are not claimed to reproduce source onset timing.

evidence_policy.melody_policy: A melody is source material only when an explicit source-backed MIDI contour is present. Generated melody is an engine interpretation, not a recovered transcription.
evidence_policy.source_refs: Optional structured source records use source_id, kind, publisher, url, claims, and community_maintained when relevant. Claims describe what the source actually supports; a source's existence does not certify every field in the progression.

measured_canon.curated_list_source: pub index.html a3185f4 YOUTUBE_TRACKS (operator canon, 22 rows; 2 ids already dead)
measured_canon.method: per stem: band energy shares (kick<130Hz, snare bp@400, hats>5kHz), onset flux peak-picking, tempo via onset-envelope autocorrelation 55-200bpm folded to 60-180, 16-slot grid via best-phase quantization (+-45ms), swing from off-8th residuals; mix: chroma (FFT 8192 @22050, 55-2200Hz) + Krumhansl key correlation
measured_canon.limits: SoundCloud transcodes decode above 0 dBFS on some rows - levels are relative evidence only; official_preview rows carry 30s windows; key estimates are single-method (Krumhansl) with weak correlations on several rows; swing assumes off-8th placement. Match classes are honest grades: official_preview, official_label, full_fan_upload, related_upload, no_match. Remixes/edits excluded.
measured_canon.source_status: external_research_evidence_not_authority: measurements bound the engine (tempo window, swing range, stem balance) but never override declared harmony; see evidence_policy.
